text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, it's actually happening! This dopamine rush might never end!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The race of my dreams is coming true! Doto's first G1 with Opera O… My oshis are gonna run together in a G1!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer! It's time to wave our light sticks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at Hanshin Racecourse, where the first face-off between T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto is getting heated.

text_block_list.name: Opera O and Doto
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah! Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O rips around from the outside! Meisho Doto is in second, holding down the inside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're lined up, and it's over! T.M. Opera O comes in first with Meisho Doto right behind her in second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O has won the momentous race by a narrow margin.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That… wasn't divine…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It was something much more. For a moment there… when I was watching my two top oshis give their all against each other…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I… even forgot how moe they are… That's how much it affected me…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… Doto, you've done well to arrive at the foot of my canopy.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is the meeting of chance I was promised. Our tale begins here!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: None but I shall run ahead of you, and none shall outpace me but you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O! I'm… so, so, so sorry to have kept you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But now that I've made it, I'll keep moving toward you… step by step!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I want to become… someone I can be proud of! And I… I need you for that!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So, please, run with me again… and again and again and again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild as the two announce their rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is this… the essence of Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Or is it unique to Opera O and Doto?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My ears are getting… hot… All the excitement has gone to my head.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It must be from this fated match-up, right? It must be because they're so special…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital, you have my thanks for attending this premiere of ours.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's your turn next. Show us how you twirl atop the sand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Digital. I'm planning to learn something from watching you run on dirt too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-okay. I'm not sure I can put on a race as divine as you two…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Still, watching your show—your race—has really energized me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we've been passed the baton, and we're up next to perform in the Japan Dirt Derby. Our search for the source of Umamusume greatness continues.
